rows.note: This is the all-purpose Cantonese noun for a cat, including a domestic cat and a feline animal in general.

example.english: This cat really likes sleeping on the sofa.
example.traditional: 呢隻貓好鍾意瞓喺張梳化度。
example.jyutping: nei1 zek3 maau1 hou2 zung1 ji3 fan3 hai2 zoeng1 so1 faa2 dou6

rows.note: Use this for a non-domesticated or wild feline rather than the ordinary domestic cat.

example.english: I saw a wild cat in the back alley last night.
example.traditional: 尋晚我喺後巷見到一隻野貓。
example.jyutping: cam4 maan5 ngo5 hai2 hau6 hong6 gin3 dou2 jat1 zek3 je5 maau1
